verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that external AI tools can connect to Basecamp: MCP support for ChatGPT, Claude, and agents; inviting AI agents into projects; and a CLI and Skills package. None of it documents Basecamp itself generating insights or suggestions from user data inside the product. These are building blocks and integrations with third-party AI, not the named in-product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
